full_details: You walked to Hewlands across the wet meadow. She was ten paces ahead in a grey gown. Bartholomew showed you the ewes and the first pink-tipped buds, put a cup on the sill, and went back to his work. At the house you told her the comedy is off the stage, that the Queen's twenty pounds was the company's, and that the Mayor at the end of your London street has never spoken to you. You gave her the canvas, sewn, and said it holds eighteen shillings, not sixty. She named malt, corn, and shoes, one pair fewer, before she untied it, and said it is the one leather. At the brook she asked whether London is where you work or where you live. You said both, and a trade in one town and a house in another. She said that was three answers. She left it, and asked the price of London butter. You had Thursday's fourpence, and no London price. In the yard you wrote three phrases on a clean leaf. In the garden, after nine seconds, you said it was not well done.
one_sentence: You gave her eighteen shillings sewn, and she counted three answers at the brook.
title: Gave eighteen shillings, and three answers at the brook
